isolation: Kabuverdianu of São Vicente only (Barlavento, island of São Vicente). Do not insert other Cabo Verdean island varieties, Guinea-Bissau Kriol, Forro, Angolar, or Lung’Ie. Do not insert Portuguese of Cabo Verde.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.
